description: Change askBeforePause for existing Ads Watch configuration. True asks before pausing; false permits normal pause rules. Changes in one call; retain a stable UUID clientRequestId. Free; creates no paid service, campaign or spend. The native preference route has no durable request-ID receipt: read current preference after uncertainty and never retry automatically. Full field guide: soclo://tools/soclo_ads_watch_ask_first_set.
name: soclo_ads_watch_ask_first_set
title: Change ask-before-pause preference
